reason: The rule requires the system to use one of the allowed crypto subpolicies (OSPP, NO-SHA1, NO-CAMELLIA, ECDHE-ONLY). Changing the subpolicy is a configuration change that does not inherently lock out SSH or break critical services, and can be tested locally before deployment. The policy explicitly allows safe remediation for such configuration changes.
estimated_impact: authentication/authorization affected; networking affected; Potential temporary loss of SSH connectivity if the new subpolicy disables ciphers currently in use
